parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the suitcase is made of durable plastic, ergonomically shaped for carrying comfort.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the suitcase easily.
parts.Movement_description: It can pivot or fold down when not in use, providing flexibility and compactness.

parts.name: Lock (Left)
parts.Basic_description: A left-side lock mechanism made of metal, providing security for the suitcase.
parts.Functional_description: It secures the lid to the base body, preventing unauthorized opening.
parts.Movement_description: It can be toggled or rotated to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Lock (Right)
parts.Basic_description: A right-side lock mechanism made of metal, identical in function to the left lock.
parts.Functional_description: It works in conjunction with the left lock to secure the suitcase lid.
parts.Movement_description: It can be toggled or rotated to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The upper shell of the suitcase made of polycarbonate, providing rigidity and protection.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the contents of the suitcase when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It is hinged to the base body and can open and close around the hinge axis.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main compartment of the suitcase made of polycarbonate, forming the structural base.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents and provides structural integrity to the suitcase.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the lid opens and closes on its hinge.
